'''Archaeologist Odum Evenpike''' is a [[dwarf]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Frostmane Hollow]], deep at the bottom of the chasm that leads to [[Hailar the Frigid]]. He was killed by the [[ice troll]]s of the [[Frostmane clan]] while searching for an old relic he presumed to be of Titan origin.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|14D|The Shattered Disc}}</ref>
